PLAN "Strength Through Pregnancy — Trimester 2/3 Bridge"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Maintain functional strength and movement quality through mid-to-late pregnancy"

PHASES

  PHASE "Phase 1 — Foundation and Positional Adaptation" (4 weeks):

    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower Body Strength A":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
          quad_stretch 2m
          child_pose 1m

      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper Body Strength A":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 1m
          lat_stretch 1m
          shoulder_stretch 1m

      DAY Friday training 50m "Full Body Strength A":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          arnold_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
